# Feature: Background Skill Node Icons

<!-- auto-generated by /implement — polish on PR #103 -->

## Intent

Hintergrund-Skill-Nodes und der Spezialisierungs-Select zeigen dieselbe Lucide-Fertigkeitsikone wie die übrigen Skill-Selects/Carousels (`SkillIcon`), damit Überzeugen & Co. visuell konsistent sind.

## Preconditions

- Branch `feat/background-skill-points-in-nodes` with `BackgroundSkillNode` and specialization Select already present.
- Existing `SkillIcon` maps every `SagaDriveSkillKey` via Lucide.

## Happy Path

- [ ] Each `BackgroundSkillNode` card shows `SkillIcon` for that skill next to the label (e.g. Überzeugen → Handshake).
- [ ] Specialization Select trigger shows the parent skill icon when a suggestion is selected.
- [ ] Each `SelectItem` in `specialization-select-*` shows the same parent skill icon beside the suggestion name.
- [ ] No second icon map or parallel icon helper is introduced.

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Empty Select (placeholder „Vorschlag wählen …“) remains readable without a forced icon.
- [ ] Custom free-text specialization (Input) is unchanged; icon stays tied to the skill node / Select options only.

## Regression

- [ ] Point −/+ and specialization apply callbacks unchanged.
- [ ] Typed-strict: no `any` / casts in touched files.

## Security Coverage

- F-03: Icons are Lucide components keyed by skill; suggestion names remain text — no HTML injection.
- No new endpoints, storage, or auth paths.

## Implementation Notes

- Reused: `src/app/character/progression/SkillIcon.tsx` (Lucide `SKILL_ICONS` map).
- Touched: `CharacterBackgroundPanel.tsx`, `progression/index.ts` (re-export).
